svg.text: Front, side, section, top. Projected from the FreeCAD solid. Each view is fitted to its window.
1080 long × 727 wide × 435 tall · mouth arch 430×158 · steel 480×500×6 · ready 38.7 kg
Dimensions mm. Do not scale the drawing. Certified burner, valve, regulator and hose are bought. No jet is drawn.
Crown objects lift at the cinch. The top rack and the stand are interfaces only and are not in the mass.
Angas is the baseline. Morning and Moondancer are the early prototypes. Neither plan sits on the lowered tailgate.
